A [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] served as '''[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]''' of the [[Gymsnor-3 light freighter/Legends|Gymsnor-3 light freighter]] ''[[Star's Delight]]'' under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lai Nootka]]. When the ''Star's Delight'' was impounded by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] authorities while delivering [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] parts and [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] to [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]], the Sullustan was taken [[Prison/Legends|prisoner]] along with the rest of the crew. They were [[Great Evacuation|rescued]] by a group of students led by [[Dynba Tesc]] in a plan devised by former [[Corellian Security Force]] [[Police officer/Legends|officer]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], and escaped the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] aboard the ''Star's Delight''.<ref name="Missed Chance" />
